programme.desc: Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex
programme.sub-title: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie makes a horrible first impression on girlfriend Zena’s parents on Taxi. Louie’s romance with girlfriend Zena takes an outrageous twist when she brings him home to meet her parents.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies try to make Tony a family man when they convince him to adopt the adorably precocious eight-year-old boy named Brian whom he befriended.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby faces a humorous predicament when it becomes obvious that one of the biggest talent managers in New York is representing him because of his prowess as a lover, and not for his ability as an actor.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a protest against unsafe equipment, the cabbies go on strike, and Louie offers an unusual solution to the problem to shop steward Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a hilarious caper, Louie and the cabbies pool all their cash to buy a painting at an auction, planning to cash in big when the artist dies—but when the bidding gets too heavy, the gang turns a dignified auction into a frolicking free-for-all.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie, the dispatcher, becomes a lovesick pup after his girlfriend finds another guy. He will stop at nothing to get her back, including recruiting Alex for his hilarious scheme—and the riotous shenanigans at the Sunshine Cab Co. never stop.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a riotous family reunion when Jim returns home to face his millionaire dad for the first time since he dropped out of society in the ‘60s, and Alex has his hands full with Jim’s voluptuous, overly amorous sister,

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The Taxi gang falls prey to hilarious fear for homeless Elaine’s romantic well-being when chivalrous Bobby allows her to live in his apartment while he is gone. Unexpectedly, he returns before she has found other quarters

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Hilarious sparks fly when Tony tries to fix up his divorced sister with Alex. Instead, she ends up falling for Reverend Jim and Tony goes outrageously overboard trying to break up the affair.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie the dispatcher has the dubious honor of being selected by his employer’s revenge-seeking wife to be her clandestine lover, and comedic panic grips the love lair when the boss shows up unexpectedly.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Wild and crazy theatrics erupt when Tony decides to become an actor and Bobby, as his skeptical agent, is aghast when Tony lands a role because he is the right type.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby’s vicious letter to a hated critic is salvaged from the wastebasket and sent to the newspaper by a gleeful Louie, setting the stage for a wild and comical night when the critic, and the cabbies, decide to take in Bobby’s one-man play.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Latka Gravas is rejected by a young beauty, he sets out on an uproarious crash course to learn to be a swinging American Bachelor, a turnabout that works fantastically with the girls but turns off all of his friends at the garage.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Jim turns into a soothsayer when he warns of a bizarre catastrophe to befall Alex that also involves an affair with a beautiful blonde.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The taxi gang hits the bricks in a hilarious hunt for new jobs when the Sunshine Cab. Co. goes out of business, with the promise that they will meet at Mario’s in one month to review their experiences.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies discover that life on the outside is not so rosy when the Sunshine Cab Co. shuts down. They all end up hilariously assuming new careers.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie turns into a jealous romantic when his overtures to accompany Elaine on her European vacation are rejected. Instead, Alex becomes the pretty cabbie's holiday companion on a tour of Europe's hot spots—culminating in a romantic rendezvous.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Riotous confusion prevails when Latka Gravas' split personalities prompt Elaine and Alex to take him to a psychiatrist's office, where the predicament takes on a wild new twist as Latka takes on Alex's personality.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Cabbie Jim Ignatowski's legendary psychic powers hilariously thrust him into the hectic world of television programming when he predicts that a TV show will be a hit.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie, at Zena's behest, comforts a girl with boyfriend woes, which leads to zany romantic tangles. Zena's rejected friend uses Louie's narrow shoulders to cry on, unleashing an unexpected comedy adventure that grants him some macho bragging rights.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie the dispatcher is gleeful, but Alex is aghast when the romantic affair between Alex and the new waitress at Mario's is complicated by another suitor.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Louie's mother announces her plans to remarry, the panicked dispatcher threatens to sever all ties with her unless she cancels the marriage.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A jubilant Tony returns to boxing as the manager of a young heavyweight, thrilling Louie, who anticipates recouping his wagering losses to Alex by betting against Banta's boxer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie carries his actions and insults too far, prompting Elaine to enlist help from a women's organization. Soon, the dispatcher's lecherous laughter is transformed into comical pleading when he is booted out of his job.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Joy blossoms at the Sunshine Cab Co. when a triumphant Bobby Wheeler returns to proclaim that he's landed a TV series role. Louie, in his own charming way, puts a damper on the celebration.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The pretty new cabbie proves to be more than Alex can handle when she leaves the meter running, in an attempt to lure him into romance.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A young runaway wreaks havoc at the Sunshine Cab Co. when Alex and Elaine encourage the lad to return home. Jim wants to adopt him, and Louie wants the youngster jailed for not paying his fare.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Mothership
programme.desc: Gjengen drar til fjellet, men noe merkelig på himmelen avbryter moroa. Er dette nok en klassisk skøyerstrek, eller er festen endelig over?

programme.desc: Etter 11 lange år får samboerne en sjokkerende overraskelse når Sammi 'Sweetheart' kommer tilbake. Kommer hun med gammel bagasje eller en ny start?

programme.desc: Etter 11 lange år får samboerne en sjokkerende overraskelse når Sammi 'Sweetheart' kommer tilbake. Kommer hun med gammel bagasje eller en ny start?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Mothership
programme.desc: Gjengen drar til fjellet, men noe merkelig på himmelen avbryter moroa. Er dette nok en klassisk skøyerstrek, eller er festen endelig over?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Sweetest Birthday
programme.desc: Pauly D får smeltet kjøttbollene. Sammis fødselsdag får Vinny til å føle seg litt salt. Da det banker på døren, står alle på tærne.

programme.desc: En overraskende gjest dukker opp i Poconos. Kjøttbollene og Sammi rigger en plan. Samboerne drar til Atlantic City for å se Pauly snurre plater. Turen får en uventet vri da dna-resultater avsløres.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Charcuterie Party
programme.desc: Guido-ene overtar Atlantic City, og Pauly tar opp kontakten med en gammel venn. Men moroa tar slutt når Snookis småkjøttfest blir dramatisk.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Margarita Problems!
programme.desc: Mike starter en etterforskning rundt omstendighetene om Angelinas biologiske far, og fortsetter å røre i gryta da etterdønningene av kjøttfesten slår til.

programme.desc: Deenas agenda for første dag med familiemoro inneholder familiebilder, margaritaer og en felles middag. Angelina og Mike setter seg ned for å snakke.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Sammi's New Man
programme.desc: Pauly knekker Guido-moten. Vinny får en uventet gjest. Deena og Angelina prøver å rense luften. Kjæresten til Sammi kommer til byen for å treffe gjengen for første gang.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Strip Steak
programme.desc: Sammis nye mann har kommet, og romkameratene setter ham på prøve. I tillegg drar gjengen på et eventyr til et av favorittstedene sine, strippeklubben.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Deena Makes a Friend
programme.desc: Dirty Stay Outs tar over strippeklubben, og Deena får en ny venn. Ronnie drar til Orlando for første gang på to år, for å gjøre opp for seg.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Frozen Pizza And Margaritas
programme.desc: Ronnie gjør opp for seg, og romkameratene slutter fred. Samtidig blir Snooki stresset av Angelina og Jennis drama.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Tequila and Theories
programme.desc: Mike fortsetter å lete etter faren til Angelina. Festløvene skaper kaos i Orlando. Gjengen har en masse teorier å forklare.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Dirty Try Out
programme.desc: MVP får lære sannheten om jorden. Sammi prøver å bli en partyfyr. Og Angelina ønsker svar av Mike.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Just Flip the Table
programme.desc: Turen er over. Kommer 'the Situation' seg ut av Orlando i live? Blir Sammi en snuskete festløve?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Familien er tilbake for å godtgjøre sine største ferietabber og avsløre store kysthemmeligheter - hvilke samboere datet i sin tid?! Pluss en hemmelig gjest etterlater kjøttbollene sparkende og skrikende - Jersey Shores familieferies gjenforening!

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Famileferiens morodag fortsetter! Margaritaer blandes og alt snus på hodet, men hvilke samboere tar en omgang på strippestangen? Finn det ut i andre del av Jersey Shores familieferies gjenforening!

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Paparazzi, pappaer og publikasjoner
programme.desc: Mike avholder en fest (for seg selv), uten at samboerne aner hvorfor. Samtidig tar Angelinas følelsesmessige reise endelig slutt.

programme.desc: Matt's reading between the lines a little too much when he thinks his attractive English professor is coming on to him.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: ...And a Nice Chianti
programme.desc: Matt stops to help a pregnant girl having car trouble and she thanks him by hijacking his car!

programme.title: 7th Heaven: And The Home of the Brave
programme.desc: Grandpa and his fiance are getting married and Annie reluctantly prepares for the reception.
programme.sub-title: And The Home of the Brave

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Johnny Get Your Gun
programme.desc: Violence invades 7th Heaven as Mary's date tries to rough her up, and Simon is threatened by a schoolmate with a gun.

programme.desc: Mary learns about the danger of natural energy boosters when a teammate is felled by the supposedly safe pills.
programme.sub-title: No Sex Some Drugs and a Little Rock 'n' Roll

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: It's sex in 7th Heaven as Mary sneaks off to a co-ed sleepover, Lucy wants to take her relationship with Jordan to the next level, and Mom befriends two pregnant unwed teens.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Here Comes Santa Claus
programme.desc: Matt works as the shopping mall Santa, and Eric and Annie exchange gifts from the heart on this 7th Heaven Christmas. Tim Conway guest stars.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Noboy Knows…
programme.desc: Mary can't get the hang of parallel parking, so she uses her feminine wiles to pass her driver's test.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: All That Jazz
programme.desc: A friend of Lucy's seeks refuge in her closet as she tries to deal with the death of his mother.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: The Tribes That Bind
programme.desc: The church ladies throw Annie a baby shower and end up snooping in her house!

programme.title: 7th Heaven: In Praise of Women
programme.desc: The Camdens await the arrival of the twins as Annie endures a long, hard labor.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: It Happened One Night
programme.desc: Matt takes a job as a fast food delivery boy to get out of the house and away from the crying babies.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Paranoia
programme.desc: Lucy's ex-boyfriend Jimmy Moon is in serious trouble, and she desperately tries to help him.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Sometimes That's Just the Way It Is

programme.sub-title: Sometimes That's Just the Way It Is

programme.desc: Mrs. Hinkle, Mary, Lucy, and even Matt and Shana lend a hand to their industrious younger siblings with the paper route.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: The Voice
programme.desc: The custodian at Simon's school tells the Reverend that he's been hearing the voice of God.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: All Dogs Go To Heaven
programme.desc: Matt's trying to look out for his younger sister, but Mary is fighting for her right to party.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: There Goes the Bride (Part 1)
programme.desc: In the first of this two-part episode, Heather is back in town and getting married, but Matt finds out an awful secret about her fiance.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: There Goes the Bride (Part 2)
programme.desc: In the dramatic conclusion of this two-part episode, Heather finds out the ugly truth about her betrothed, while Matt tries to convince Shana that he still loves her.

programme.title: Legacy of Rage
programme.desc: Brandon er en almindelig mand, men hans bedste ven, Michael, er en skummel narkohandler, som er forelsket i Brandons kæreste. Da Michael myrder en betjent, og giver sin ven skylden, vender Brandon tilbage for at få hævn. Filmen vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: Wah vet knapt ordet av det før han har blitt fralurt pengene sine. Han legger de siste slantene på en rose fra en blomsterhandler som mener at blomstene hennes fører med seg lykke og velstand. Og riktig nok ser Wah snart at flaksen har snudd.

programme.desc: Linda gets a Little Sister and learns a lesson about rebellion while John meddles in Reggies love life.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Factories of Death
programme.desc: Året 1942 skal bli det mest betydningsfulle i "Den Endelige Løsningen", ettersom nazistene nå begynner å gjennomgå Vest-Europa og til og med tar jøder fra steder så fjernt som de britiske Kanaløyene.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Corruption
programme.desc: I 1943 er korrupsjonen løpsk på Auschwitz-Birkenau. Leiren får også en ny inntektskilde – klær og verdifulle eiendeler tatt fra jøder som kommer for å bli gasset.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”, the biggest aircraft in WWII.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls get their makeovers and the inevitable tears and tantrums follow. The girls pair up for a girl on girl photo shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls learn about cheese cake pin-up and dancing from Britain's own 'Queen of Burlesque' Immodesty Blaize. Two girls recieve harsh criticism from casting director Beth Charkham when faced with the challenge of a commercial set in a swimming pool.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The remaining models learn about ballroom dancing from top ballroom dancer Brendan Cole and Lianna struggles to get it right. Then they do a full dance with music. One girl gets upset when not chosen by the winner to join her for her reward.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls train with personal trainer Chris Mundle. Then straight after training, sweating and smelling, they head to meet top designers. They have a Gothic Bride photo shoot, with most girls struggling to get a good shot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The remaining models undergo a heavy metallic make-up photo shoot with John Swanell. Lisa arrives at the house and the girls have to critique each other, which causes even more fights. A practical joke gets taken the wrong way.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls shoot a thirty second jewellery promotion with top promo director Jason Clifford. Lucy, last years winner, visits the girls and gives them some tips. They have a country life photo shoot and there is a shock at elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: With two people gone the house becomes even more divided. The girls meet Saffron Aldridge, top style expert, who goes through their wardrobes with no mercy. They have a one on one with Lisa and the girls are awe-struck when they meet a famous model.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The four remaining models head to Morocco and Lisa gives them the day off. They are given the challenge of finding an outfit for Lisa. They have their first Moroccan photo shoot and the final three are chosen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In the finale the three remaining models have their final photo shoot and the final two compete in a catwalk show and one girl is crowned 'Britain's Next Top Model'.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls immediately face their first challenge, posing in front of the press. They then meet stylist Hilary Alexander, who asks them when they lost their virginity and what they think about unprotected sex.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls take part in a catwalk challenge set by Otis Isles, the internationally respected casting director, model agent, and fashion producer, who tells them to dress in underwear.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at the English National Ballet School, where Lisa introduces them to ballet teacher Louise Halliday. They learn about the art of ballet to help with their movement.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls order a pizza and find Lisa Mail for the challenge the following morning. A huge fight breaks out between Stefanie and Louise.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are taken to Debenhams, where they get the chance to meet Caprice. They are given fifteen minutes to find an outfit for different occasions.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at a bar where they meet music video director Paul Hills. Their challenge is to star in a music video along with The Wolfmen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are woken up by a grueling morning workout from Celebrity Personal Trainer Nicki Waterman. Some struggle with the workout, especially Sherece.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at Models 1, where they meet Mark Evans along with casting agents. They take a Polaroid shot for a casting. Mark announces that they will be going to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but there are only four places on the plane.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kansas City Royals pitcher Tim Collins wants a ‘super-fast’ 1968 Mustang, but Dan has to first undo a nightmare combination of bad repairs and unsafe systems. Bob needs a FantomWorks reality check to get his beloved 1950 Willy’s Jeep back on the road.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Walter loves the fast and futuristic look of his 1975 Bricklin. Unfortunately, the car drives like something from the dark ages. Dan restores a 1963 Split Window Corvette for a pair of owners who know him well – his Uncle Carl and Aunt Claire.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas

programme.desc: Reno's surprise reunion with Leeza Bendetti at Bobby's scenic Duck Lake cabin is soured when he stumbles upon a trio of drug dealers.

programme.title: Renegade

programme.title: Renegade

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E6 - Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E7 - John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.desc: When Moya is raided by bounty hunters working for the Peacekeepers, every crew member is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E9 - A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya and her crew are resupplying on a generally xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect while under a strange form of suggestion.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E9 - A Prefect Murder

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E10 - Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. Although if not ingested by the same person, it becomes toxic.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E10 - Coup By Clam

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E11 - Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets up with a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E12 - Kansas
programme.desc: After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985 and he has altered the timeline.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E13 - Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived on Earth. Even though the Moya crew relaxes on Earth and are treated as VIPs, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E14 - Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, Talikaa. However, Talikaa turns out to be an alien in disguise and is intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E15 - Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The males of the crew undergo some training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes. While D'Argo learns some self-control.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E15 - Mental As Anything

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E16 - Bringing Home The Beacon

programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E16 - Bringing Home The Beacon

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E17 - A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a television documentary about himself and the aliens.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E17 - A Constellation Of Doubt

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E18 - Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities' where Crichton believes he heard Stark say 'Katratzi.'

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E19 - We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction

programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E19 - We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E20 - We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi

programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E20 - We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi

programme.sub-title: Farscape: S4 E21 - We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E22 - Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole as those flowers grow there.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E1 - Premiere

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: 4400s across the world are coming down with strange and life threatening illnesses. Tom and Diana learn a horrible secret that the government may have directly caused the illnesses of the 4400s.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Discovering that NTAC is behind the disease plaguing the 4400s, Tom and Diana try to get to the bottom of NTAC's cover-up, while Kyle considers turning himself in.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana, with the help of Gary Navarro, try to track down T.J Kim, a 4400 whose ability they believe caused a man to stab Dennis Ryland. Richard and Lily are forced to deal with a now grown Isabelle.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro is arrested after attempting to assassinate Dennis Ryland. Isabelle attempts suicide in the hope of saving her mother, but fails when she survives a fall from the roof of the 4400 Center.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santanico confronts Malvado with Seth's help, while Richie and Kate must stop Carlos and Scott from overturning the ancient prophecy and taking control of a powerful evil.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth and Santanico clash with Richie over his betrayal, while Carlos and Scott aim to take Malvado's empire and unleash culebra frenzy on the world.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: After the Lords demote Seth and Richie to collectors, their organization is infiltrated by a mysterious new enemy bent on destroying the Geckos, the Lords, and all culebras.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Season three of "From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series" continues the Gecko brothers' saga as they fight their way through the chilling world of culebras, the vampire-snake hybrids that control hidden empires in Texas and Mexico.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Ranger Freddie Gonzalez must team up with an old enemy to bring down a demon hell-bent on enslaving culebras. Meanwhile, Seth and Richie track down an ancient hunter.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: When Amaru puts Scott Fuller in her sights, the Geckos and their team must defend him against Brasa's most lethal fighters yet - Jaguar Warriors from hell.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: A cannibal attack in a suburban neighborhood forces Seth to bring his makeshift team together to save innocent civilians.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: After being kidnapped by Amaru, Richie wakes up in an abandoned asylum and calls Seth for help. Sensing a trap, Seth brings the team - and Amaru unleashes a demon like no other.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.
